answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Work waits on the opal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the glacier of the next round. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
